notes.title: Early Access release day!
notes.content:
The title says it all really, FURO is now available in Early Access!

A quick reminder of what's included in the Early Access release, and also what's planned for the future:

[h3]Features available in Early Access:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Loads of levels, in a variety of bizarre environments!
[*]Complete levels and challenges to unlock stars which can be spent on, well, more levels!
[/list]
[h3]Planned feature additions:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Multiplayer (Online):[/b] Compete with other players to complete levels in the quickest time!
[*][b]Level Editor:[/b] Create levels and share them with others!
[*][b]Wildcards:[/b] Think of these like a variety of "weapon mods". Slow down time to traverse fast moving "platforms" easier, teleport from one part of the level to another, regenerate health, and more!
[/list]
